info.title: Community Giving API
info.description:
Core API for the Community Giving Platform. Owns all money logic; the only service with PayPal credentials.

* Money is integer minor units in fields ending in `_cents`, with a currency code (USD).
* Errors are `{"detail": {"error": CODE, "message": text}}`.
* Routes not built yet return their example response with an `X-Stub` header (or **501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED** when `STUB_EXAMPLES=false`). Don't treat their data as real.
* Authorization: admin routes (paths under /admin/) take the admin console's bearer token, ADMIN_TOKEN; agent routes (under /internal/) take the agent service's bearer token, INTERNAL_TOKEN. Both go in the Authorization header (see the HTTPBearer security scheme).

post.description:
Computes final results and adds each project's match to its next milestone tranche.

Waits while any Watchdog case is open: the round moves to `closing`, the answer is 409
WAITING_FOR_CASES, and it closes on its own (background loop) once the cases are resolved.
Rounds also close on their own at their end time; this route is for closing now.

Verifies the signature, skips repeats by event id, then handles PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED,

PAYMENT.PAYOUTS-ITEM.* events, and the Giving Agent subscription events (PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED,
BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.*). Other types are recorded as ignored.
